new_result_summary: For a physical cross block B with fixed row/column anchors, incident third-volume J3>0 and residual second-volume E2>0, let delta_r be the probability that independent determinant-squared residual row pairs from the incident-E3 and residual-E2 laws are disjoint. If delta_r>0, then integral |phi_Q| <= 10*pi*e*2^(-1/5) delta_r^(-1/10)(J3 E2)^(-1/10), and ||p_Q||infinity <=5e*2^(-1/5) delta_r^(-1/10)(J3 E2)^(-1/10). Same by transpose for delta_c. This is a genuine unweighted L1 characteristic-function branch, with continuity, and it requires no nonzero outer cross edge.
live_application: On two-sided D' failure at q=4/3, choose heavy physical row/column anchors. Their joint incident third-volume satisfies J3>Z3/3. If E2>0 and max(delta_r,delta_c)>=eta, then ||p_Q||infinity <(5e/2^(1/5))[3/(eta Z3 E2)]^(1/10). At eta=1/16 this is <17.425395 (Z3 E2)^(-1/10). D5 independently pays ||p_Q||infinity <=(5e/sqrt(2))E5(B)^(-1/10).
failure_certificate: If delta_r,delta_c<eta, fixed residual physical row/column pairs H,L carry >1-2eta of the E2 law jointly, so one physical anchor (i,j) has H2^(i,j)(N)>(1-2eta)E2/4. At eta=1/16 this is >7E2/32.
